meta.name: J-Style Trip
meta.description: Megastar Jay Chou joins his A-list friends in this globe-trotting variety show packed with music and magic tricks.

videos.title: Paris
videos.overview: Pigalle, Centre Pompidou, Rive Gauche. Jay Chou and Jam Hsiao play basketball and dazzle bystanders with magic tricks.

videos.title: Singapore (I)
videos.overview: Formula One, the Merlion, Sim Lim Square. Jay shows off telekinetic magic and sings "Love Confession" with JJ Lin at karaoke.

videos.title: Singapore (II)
videos.overview: Marina Bay Sands, go-karting, Sentosa. Magician Will Tsai stuns with a disappearing necklace act at the aquarium.

videos.title: Taipei
videos.overview: East District, Ximending, Shilin Night Market. After some milk tea magic, Jay, Chen Chien-chou and friends reminisce about their school days.

videos.title: Vienna, Innsbruck
videos.overview: The Wiener Musikverein, the Mozarthaus, the Hofburg. Lang Lang reflects on music, art and history. Jay and his squad then head to Innsbruck.

videos.title: Gold Coast (I)
videos.overview: Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary, boomerangs, Cavill Avenue. After a stop in Sydney, Jay and crew pet a koala and show off more card tricks.

videos.title: Gold Coast (II)
videos.overview: Yachting, yabbies, Sea World. Jay discovers parasailing and cooks a fish dinner with the crew.

videos.title: Shenzhen (I)
videos.overview: Lang Lang Music World. Jay, Lang Lang and crew put on disguises and inspire young pianists.

videos.title: Shenzhen (II)
videos.overview: Lang Lang discusses his creative collaborations, and Jay gears up for the big show at the Universiade Sports Centre.

videos.title: Tokyo (I)
videos.overview: Harajuku, Daikanyama, soba. Magician Cyril Takayama cooks up food magic tricks, and pop star Ryota Katayose makes a guest appearance.

videos.title: Tokyo (II)
videos.overview: Sunset, Kabukicho, Shibuya. On Halloween night, Jay dresses up as Kato and draws a big crowd. With a special visit from Mayday.

videos.title: Mount Fuji
videos.overview: Yohji Yamamoto's office, Rainbow Bridge, road trip. Jay and crew catch up with Hong Kong actor and chef Nicholas Tse.

videos.title: Havana
videos.overview: Morro Castle, Plaza Vieja, salsa. Taiwanese singer Alan Kuo drives Jay and crew on a sightseeing tour.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In Taipei, Fish Leong joins Jay and his friends to embark on their first adventure — and showcases her incredible culinary talents.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A visit to Vincent Fang's studio uncovers the unique bond between Jay and his creative partner, while Lay Zhang finally confides in his childhood hero.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Arriving in New Zealand, Jay takes his gang to an immersive Māori culture experience, followed by a trip to a world-class visual effects studio.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: In the scenic Yilan County, Jay and Zax Wang set out on a relaxing trip filled with gourmet cooking, close-up magic and heartwarming fireside chats.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Reuniting with old pal Will Liu, Jay takes on a memory-filled trip in Xiamen. Meanwhile, students at two schools are in for some J-style surprises.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Teaming up with violinist Ray Chen, Jay takes his music and magic to the streets of Sydney and the city's world-famous Opera House.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: After a relaxing brunch at a charming cafe, the gang heads to Newtown. With one of them masquerading as Jay, can the fans see through the disguise?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Teaming up with world-renowned DJ Steve Aoki, Jay and his friends take a deep dive into California's vibrant lowrider scene.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: In Paris, superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme takes Jay on a tour of the city and its cuisine. Later, the gang searches for a legendary château in Bordeaux.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Venturing into legendary winery Château Lafite Rothschild, Jay and his friend stumble upon a series of delightful surprises.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: From the Abbey of Mont Saint-Michel to the cliffs of Étretat, Jay and his gang continue to explore scenic vistas and delicious cuisines in France.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Jay and his pals dive into French culture in Trouville and Deauville, where a historic seafood market and equestrian center capture their attention.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: On the other side of the world, Jay and his gang get ready for a brand new adventure in Melbourne. Plus, they find another megastar travel buddy: A-mei.

videos.title: Special Episode
videos.overview: In the season finale, Jay leads his friends on a time travel adventure back to Australia's Gold Rush era at the unique open-air museum, Sovereign Hill.
